text.en: Reviewers warmly commend groomers Mollie, Tamsin, and Patrycja for their exceptional care and welcoming approach. Pet parents appreciate how immediately the stylists put anxious dogs and nervous owners at ease, maintaining high standards of personal attention and unhurried patience throughout every appointment.

Owners of nervous dogs, puppies, and pets sensitive to nail clipping report that their animals settle happily in the studio. Reviewers note that dogs warm up quickly to the stylists, enjoy the calm one-to-one atmosphere, and show genuine enthusiasm whenever they return for subsequent grooming visits.

Clients are delighted with the finished appearance and coat condition of their pets. Reviewers emphasize that dogs leave looking immaculate, neatly brushed, and wonderfully scented, praising thorough de-shedding packages and precise scissor trims tailored perfectly to each breed's coat.

q.en: Where is Hot Dogs Grooming located?

a.en: The parlour is situated at Containerville on Emma Street in East London, serving local pets with one-to-one appointments.

q.en: Does the parlour groom nervous dogs or puppies?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the team for their gentle handling during introductory puppy grooms and first-time sessions.

q.en: Are pet pick-up and drop-off services available?

a.en: Yes, the business offers a local collection and delivery service for pet owners in East London neighbourhoods.
